items.explanation: Use the established time expression 一百岁的时候, with 的 before 时候.
Here the noun 花 needs an adjective phrase. 毒 is a noun, so use 有毒的花.
Death is a completed event here, so use 死了 rather than 开始死.
Use 的 before 时候 in this time phrase: 生病的时候.
It would be more natural to say 什么是毒 after 什么植物是药; the omitted noun 植物 is already clear.
Here 毒 needs the adjective form 有毒. Say 什么植物有毒.
